# The `snes-single` ES-DE fixture

A placeholder of I3 step 0a, which settles the folder; I3 step 1c builds the fixture, its `files.json` payloads and
this README's layout and counts, which tests assert.

The room of G06 (docs/roadmap.md, I3; style §21's P0 single-ROM room): one cartridge system whose full name is
invented, one ROM and no media at all, so that every game is eligible and the room is furnished from the template
alone. Nothing commercial: no real title or system name.
